slacs_gold.description: SLACS lenses reduced so far: the working sample. Every lens here has ACS/WFC F814W; 22 have WFPC2 F606W, 16 have ACS F555W, 13 have WFC3/IR F160W.

slacs_other.description: The remaining SLACS lenses from Bolton et al. 2008 Table 4 (info/slacs_coords.py) that are not in slacs_gold. Restricted to Bolton et al. 2008 Table 4 classification E-S-A or L-S-A (early-type or late-type, single lens, clear multiple imaging; the '*' variants E-S-A*/L-S-A* count too -- Bolton's footnote confirms them as definite lenses, just excluded from their own lens modeling) -- all other classifications (X, B, M, U) excluded. Not yet reduced; HST coverage per lens is unknown and is discovered by querying MAST. Any GAL-* MAST target names for these are undiscovered, so a no-data result here is weaker evidence than it is for slacs_gold.

gallery.description: BELLS GALLERY (HST proposals 14189, 16734), WFC3/UVIS multi-band (F225W, F275W, F438W, F606W, F814W). Restricted to Shu et al. 2016 Table 1 classification E-S-A (early-type, single lens, clear multiple imaging) — L-S-X, E-M-A, E-S-X, and E-S-M systems excluded. mast_target holds each lens's full SDSS coordinate designation, the MAST target name for this sample (see 'Non-standard MAST target names' in AGENTS.md). Reduction scripts not yet written.

bells.description: BELLS (Brownstein et al. 2012), HST GO-12209, ACS/WFC F814W (~2200-2400 s per lens). Restricted to Brownstein et al. 2012 Table 3 classification E-S-A or L-S-A (early- or late-type, single lens, clear multiple imaging; 21 + 3), the same rule as slacs_other. J1522+2910 (E-M-A) and all grade B/C/X systems excluded. Disjoint from gallery by construction (BELLS sources are [OII]/Hb/[OIII] emitters at z_s < 1.5). MAST target names are the short SDSS<LENS> form, so no mast_target overrides. Not yet reduced.

sl2s_dinos_a.description: SL2S lenses with deep WFC3/UVIS F475X from GO-17130 (Project Dinos II, Sheu+2025) PLUS a second band: WFPC2 F606W (GO-11289, lens on WF3) or ACS F814W (GO-10876). F475X is restricted to GO-17130 (proposals quirk). Roster agreed 2026-10-04; see AGENTS.md *SL2S samples*. Not yet reduced.
